title: Neem Baba
subject: English
summary: “Neem Baba” is a story about the importance of the neem tree and its many benefits. In this chapter, a young girl talks to Neem Baba and learns about the uses of the neem tree. Neem leaves, bark, flowers and seeds are useful in many ways. Neem has medicinal properties and helps us stay healthy. It also protects the environment by providing shade and fresh air. Neem is used in making medicines, soaps and other products. The story teaches us that trees are very useful to us, and we should protect and plant more trees to keep our environment healthy.
